scope: Fixed no-refit metric-support ablation on four repeatedly seen DEVELOPMENT states and 64 cached plans each; no new model/simulator calls.
unit: Equal-weight state, n=4, not 256 independent plans

predicted_result.interpretation: Complement removal changes ranking and exposes small coverage gains, but the learned weighting does not outperform its matched rotated controls. This is not recovered task alignment.

complement_diagnostics.interpretation: Complement has larger candidate-cost contrasts as well as larger mean energy; mean energy alone would not establish ranking dominance. Removing it is still not sufficient for learned-specific utility.

actual_encoding_channel.scope: Offline oracle diagnosis, not a runtime operator; deltas use native actual-encoding choice as baseline.
actual_encoding_channel.interpretation: True-future encoding also exhibits a complement/support issue, particularly state3, rather than a gain unique to learned weights.

limitations: Weights were originally fitted with complement included; dropping complement is an intentionally fixed ablation, not a newly optimized span-only metric.
All results adaptive development, no confirmatory inference, full-rollout efficacy, or steering promotion.
Dropping complement changes cost support but leaves every cached action and physical outcome unchanged.
Requested-goal polygon coverage and combined agent/block XY distance remain separate outcomes.
